card.name: Head nouns before a describing phrase
card.fires_on: A singular or plural noun like act, trial, test, table, software, vaccine or injection that ends a noun phrase right after a modifier. The next words usually add detail about it, such as a verb or 'validated to'.

modes.description: Nouns like table, injection, software or vaccine that follow a drug or type name and name the thing itself.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese particles and noun-like pieces, so the pole adds little clear output effect beyond expecting a continuation after a noun.
card.plain: It lights up on a noun that finishes a short phrase, such as test, table or injection, when more description is about to follow.
